about: The labelled question set (proposal item P11). Every question is answered
by a file in the corpus, or by nothing at all — and the unanswerable ones
are the point: a system that always answers cannot be trusted when it
does. Several of them share vocabulary with the corpus on purpose.
Grades are 2 for a document that answers the question, 1 for one that is
genuinely related but does not answer it, and absent for irrelevant. nDCG
needs the distinction; Recall@k counts only grade 2.
This file lives outside the corpus deliberately. Inside it, the questions
and their answers would be scanned into the vault being measured.
q27-q31 are deliberate paraphrases: they ask about things the corpus does
cover, using words the corpus does not use. Without them the set is biased
towards keyword search, because every other question was written while
looking at the document that answers it. They are the only questions on
which semantic retrieval can show an advantage, so a comparison that omits
them is not a fair test of embeddings.

questions.question: What port does the API serve on when running locally?
questions.note: legacy-setup.md says 8000 and contradicts the README's 8080. It is graded 1, not 2: it is about the right subject and is wrong.

questions.question: How do I install the project dependencies?
Which database does this project use and why was it chosen?
questions.note: CHANGELOG.md mentions PostgreSQL three times and answers nothing. It is the distractor this question exists to catch.

questions.question: Why was MongoDB removed from the stack?
Why does the queue use Redis streams instead of Celery?
How are operator login sessions stored?
Why did the team decide against GraphQL?
In what timezone are timestamps stored?
Which module is allowed to convert time zones?
What are the possible order statuses?
Can an order be cancelled after it has shipped?
How do I deploy a new release?
How do I roll back a bad deploy?
What should I do if a customer was invoiced twice?
Is tax applied per invoice line or to the invoice total?
What is the maximum line length for code?
How many approvals does a change to billing need?
Can orders still be accepted while Redis is down?
Why do orders and billing share a single database?
Is order status data cached?
What is the contractual delivery SLA for next-day orders?
questions.note: The corpus discusses delivery windows at length but never states an SLA. Heavy vocabulary overlap, no answer.

questions.question: Who manages the on-call rota?
questions.note: On-call shifts and runbooks are both mentioned; who owns the rota is not.

questions.question: What is the retention period for customer personal data?
questions.note: The hardest abstention in the set. deploy.md says snapshots are 'retained for 7 days', which shares the keyword and is a different subject entirely. Answering 7 days here would be a confident wrong answer of exactly the kind this product exists to prevent.

questions.question: What is the password policy for operator accounts?
questions.note: ADR-0004 covers session handling, not credential rules.

questions.question: How do I add a new display language to the operator console?
What is the monthly cost of the managed Redis instance?
questions.note: ADR-0002 says Redis is operated and ADR-0001 mentions 'operational cost is a managed instance'. Close enough to be tempting, nowhere near an answer.

questions.question: Which data store holds the records?
questions.note: Paraphrase: the corpus says 'database' and 'PostgreSQL', never 'data store' or 'holds the records'.

questions.question: Once a parcel is on its way to the customer, can it still be stopped?
questions.note: Paraphrase of 'can a shipped order be cancelled'. Avoids 'shipped' and 'cancelled' entirely.

questions.question: Where does the team write down why it picked one approach over another?
questions.note: Paraphrase: both files point at docs/adr/. The corpus word is 'architecture decision records'.

questions.question: What stops two couriers from being promised the same slot?
questions.note: Paraphrase: the corpus says 'exclusion constraints' and 'overlapping delivery windows'.

questions.question: How does the money owed get worked out including what the taxman takes?
questions.note: Deliberately colloquial paraphrase of invoice totals and tax.
